title: Projective space over an affine base and its open inclusion
statement: Work in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $n\geq0$. In the category of schemes [def-pc-scheme] over $\operatorname{Spec}A$, define $P=\mathbf P^n_A=\operatorname{Proj}(A[x_0,\ldots,x_n])$ with its canonical structure morphism, using [def-pc-projective-space-twist]. For every open subset $V\subset P$, define the corresponding open subscheme over $\operatorname{Spec}A$ by the composite $V\hookrightarrow P\to\operatorname{Spec}A$. Regard both schemes as their Yoneda algebraic spaces by [def-trf-scheme-algebraic-space]. Define their inclusion to be the actual morphism of these representable sheaves induced by the open immersion $V\hookrightarrow P$.
